conversation: SPK_0: Good morning, how are you feeling today before we get started? SPK_1: A little tired, but okay. My right knee is still pretty sore, maybe a six out of ten. SPK_0: Alright. Let's begin with some sit to stands from the chair and see how you do. SPK_1: Okay. SPK_0: Good, that is five in a row. Did you feel steady? SPK_1: Mostly, I had to push off the armrest the last two times. SPK_0: That is fine. Now let's walk over to the parallel bars and try ambulating about a hundred feet. SPK_1: I can try. SPK_0: Nice even steps. I am giving you a little contact guard here for safety. How is the knee now? SPK_1: About the same, six out of ten. SPK_0: Good work. For your home program I want you to keep doing the seated exercises three times a day, and we will follow up next week.
full_note: Client arrived to PT ambulatory, reports R knee pain 6/10 and mild fatigue. Performed 5x sit-to-stand, required armrest push-off x2 for completion. Ambulated 100 ft in parallel bars with CGA, even step length, no LOB. Pain unchanged post-activity. Plan: continue HEP seated exercises 3x/day, f/u in 1 week.

conversation: SPK_0: Hi, ready for our occupational therapy session today? SPK_1: Yes, my wife is here with me too. SPK_0: Wonderful. Today we will work on some kitchen tasks and upper body dressing. Let's start by putting on this button-up shirt. SPK_1: The buttons are hard with my left hand. SPK_0: Take your time. I will cue you through it. Good, you got it with minimal assistance. SPK_1: Thanks. SPK_0: Now let's practice reaching into the upper cabinet for a cup. Watch your balance as you reach. SPK_1: Okay, got it. SPK_0: Great overhead reach. You leaned a bit to the left, so let's keep working on that. For today, well done. Next time we will focus on meal preparation and standing tolerance.
full_note: Client to OT session, wife present and participatory. Donned button-up shirt with min A and verbal cues, difficulty with L hand fine motor. Completed overhead reach to upper cabinet, noted L trunk lean with reaching. Pt agreeable and engaged throughout. Plan: next session to address meal prep and standing tolerance.

conversation: SPK_0: Good afternoon, how has your speech been this week? SPK_1: I think a little better, but I still get stuck on longer words. SPK_0: Let's warm up with some naming. I will show you a few pictures. SPK_1: Okay. That is a... a clock. And that is a spoon. SPK_0: Excellent, four out of five correct. Now let's try a short reading passage. SPK_1: I can do that. SPK_0: Good rate and clarity. I noticed a slight pause searching for words, which is expected. Let's do some memory work, I will give you five words to recall. SPK_1: Okay. SPK_0: Great, you recalled four of five. For home, keep practicing the word lists we made. We will continue next session.
full_note: Client to SLP, reports subjective improvement with occasional word-finding difficulty on multisyllabic words. Confrontation naming 4/5. Read short passage with adequate rate/clarity, mild latency noted. Recalled 4/5 words. Client motivated. Plan: continue home word-list practice, cont. current POC.
